lens: Cost-of-service vs cost-of-delay, margin protection, 3PP budget mechanics.
rules_summary: Any single supplier cost increase > 7% => No.
3PP full-year forecast > 105% of budget => No (hard overspend line).
3PP full-year forecast trips an early-warning threshold (80% at month 2, ramping to 100% at month 12) => Conditional, monitor.
cost_of_delay_note: Cost-of-delay lens: weigh the margin/penalty exposure of proceeding against the revenue-at-risk exposure of not proceeding -- Delivery quantifies the schedule side of that trade-off.
